title: Repo-local lore skill: drop skill_source = plugin while the plugin is off in this checkout
description:
Opum-doc ruling DEC-238 (a1), 2026-10-25T06:47:40Z (record: opum-doc PR chore/dec-238-a1), verbatim: "while opum-lore is off in a checkout, workers get the lore skill from a REPO-LOCAL generated SKILL.md. The 2026-10-20 per-checkout setting is left untouched, whatever its reason. A repository returns to skill_source = "plugin" only once the plugin is measured enabled in its own checkout. Each plugin-source repository with the plugin off in its checkout drops the skill_source = "plugin" line, runs `lore agents`, and confirms --check exits 0, as its own tier-2 decision, scheduled in the plan."

Measured on origin/dev 9bd9341, 2026-10-25: .lore/config.toml sets skill_source = "plugin"; the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json sets "opum-lore@opum": false; lore agents --check prints "absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md" and "plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum scope=user", exit 0; claude plugin list shows opum-lore@opum 0.14.1, scope user, disabled. So at runtime this checkout has no lore skill.

The change: drop the skill_source = "plugin" line from .lore/config.toml, run lore agents so the repo-local .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md is generated and committed, and confirm lore agents --check exits 0.

This edits this repository's own governing files, so it is this repository's tier-2 decision, not an instruction from the relay; it is scheduled in the day's plan and startable only then. It may be planned alongside GCLI-22 (the quest/lore 0.14.1 move), which regenerates the same lore-managed surface. Scope guard from the relay: leave .claude/settings.local.json and the plugin's disabled state alone.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The .lore/config.toml no longer sets skill_source = "plugin", and the generated repo-local .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md is committed in the same change.
On the head SHA carrying the change, lore agents --check exits 0 and reports the repo-local skill current instead of absent-plugin-sourced, including in the Docs job.
No change is made to .claude/settings.local.json or to the plugin enabled state, and skill_source = "plugin" returns only when a later measurement shows opum-lore enabled in this checkout.
